lessons.trigger_condition: post-merge GPT TCG Drive Package sees both STALE_SOCIAL_SNAPSHOT and STALE_AUTO_UPDATE_REPORT; the previous recovery recognized only the single auto-update stale code and returned the original package failure instead of dispatching a fresh protected static refresh
lessons.prevention_rule: keep all social/report freshness thresholds fail-closed; treat a non-empty critical-code set as freshness-only only when it is a subset of the explicit stale freshness allowlist; dispatch the protected static refresh, mark package ready=false, upload nothing, and preserve the original non-zero result for any non-freshness critical finding
validation_required: the exact newly uncovered Tablet GPT watched path is .github/workflows/gpt-tcg-drive-package.yml
STALE_SOCIAL_SNAPSHOT and STALE_AUTO_UPDATE_REPORT are the only allowed freshness-only critical codes
the critical-code set must be non-empty and a subset of the explicit freshness allowlist
freshness-only recovery dispatches tcg-static-data-refresh.yml on main, sets ready=false, and uploads no stale package
any non-freshness critical finding preserves the original non-zero package result
freshness thresholds are not widened or bypassed
v364 contract/delta/receipt/test quartet is complete and digest-consistent
model weights, raw grading calibration, and device-local runtime memory are not transferred
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: do not turn freshness-only recovery into stale-data acceptance; recovery may request a protected recollection but may never upload stale evidence or suppress unrelated critical findings
